page.layout: Page header "INDEX" at top. Two columns of index entries, left column first, then right column. The right column is cut off partway through its last line. The left column continues below the cut. No page number, catchword or signature in this part.; One column of index entries, right of centre, with page numbers at the right of each entry. Partly cut at the top. A fragment of the page foot ("te.", "312") is at the bottom edge.

main_text.l: vniuersi natura nihil extra se habet. 284.
vniuersi naturæ nihil vsitatius, quàm mutare & innouare. 210
volucres vnde futura indicandi vim fortitæ. 103

page.notes: The right column is cut off, so its last line ("viuere quid", page number 246) is incomplete. The final left-column line ("viuendum tanquã in mon-") is also cut off. The rendering of "quàm" and "quã" (macron or tilde) is uncertain but read as printed. The top line is cut, so its page number "34" and its opening are only partly visible. The "te." at the lower left is a fragment, possibly the end of a line from the page below, and is not transcribed as text. The "vtilis" line at the foot may continue on the cut-off part of the page. The numbers "142", "235", "121." and "301" stand alone on their own lines and are kept as printed, as the page numbers of the entries above them. "vlulas" and "vlcisçêdi" are read with some uncertainty.
